setup.alreadySetUp: Kraki is already set up on this PC
setup.windowsDetail: Kraki for Windows runs Kraki in the background and updates it with the app. Your sign-in and sessions carry over.

setup.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings → This PC.
setup.existingCLI: The command-line version of Kraki{{version}} already runs your agents in the background. You only need one of them.

thisPC.agentsHelp: Kraki uses the agents installed and signed in on this PC. Install or sign in to an agent in its own app or in Terminal, then click Check Again.
thisPC.cliDetail: The command-line Kraki runs the agents on this PC. You update it from a terminal.
thisPC.switchDetail: Switching stops the command-line Kraki's background service and keeps your sign-in and sessions.
thisPC.background: Kraki runs in the background and starts when you sign in to Windows.
thisPC.remoteOnly: When off, this PC only controls agents on your other computers.
thisPC.installDetail: Install Kraki, or locate an existing command-line installation.
thisPC.remoteUpdates: Let my other devices update Kraki on this PC
thisPC.updatesHelp: From your phone or another computer, you can update Kraki here when a new version is out. Kraki restarts for a few seconds; running sessions are only stopped if you choose to.

agents.copilotBlurb: GitHub Copilot in the terminal. Needs a Copilot plan.
agents.piBlurb: An open coding agent that works with many model providers and your own API keys.
agents.looking: Looking for coding agents on this PC…
agents.noneFound: No coding agent found on this PC yet.
agents.installHelp: Kraki runs agents like Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI or Pi. Install one, sign in to it, then click Check Again.
agents.supportedHelp: Kraki runs the agents you install on this PC, with your own accounts. Install an agent and sign in to it once in a terminal, then click Check Again.
